sample_mapping_evidence: Primary PMID32351504 Results and Figure2 explicitly report one subject for unexpanded adult peripheral blood Tregs. GSM4446060 is the sole adult pre-expansion RNA capture. Cord blood, expanded cells and paired VDJ assays do not supply additional direct adult PBMC observations. APB_pre_subject1 is a local opaque label derived from the explicitly reported single subject, not a published donor identifier or a globally unique identity.

source_processing: fastq files were generated from bcl files using cellranger mkfastq

T-cell receptor annotations were generated using cellranger vdj

source_metadata.source_barcode_scope: Original raw droplet whitelist; barcode rows are not called cells. Existing minimum RNA QC applied before constructing AnnData; no new threshold or RNA count changes.

title: APB_Treg_Pre_GEX
extract_protocol_ch1: Gene expression and V(D)J libraries were prepared from 5,000 pre- and post-expansion CB and APB Treg cells using the Chromium Single Cell 50 Bead and Library Kit v1 and the Chromium Single Cell V(D)J Human TCR Analysis Kit (10X Genomics). Libraries were sequenced on an Illumina HiSeq instrument at a target read depth of 50,000 reads per cell.
